title: 34 South Briland Lane Carriage House | Royal Destinations
meta_description: Stunning Carriage House of Gulf Front Home at Beach Access with Views!
description_expanded: Description: 34 S Briland Lane Carriage House by Royal Destinations Address: 34 South Briland Lane Location: Rosemary Beach Details: Nestled amongst the trees and boardwalks of elegant Rosemary Beach is a beautiful luxury carriage house offering the utmost comfort with beach access right outside the door. 34 South Briland Lane is perched along the Emerald Coast that surrounds the picturesque Gulf waters on which Rosemary Beach overlooks, encapsuling beach living at its finest. This destination marries timeless style, a tranquil palette and designer comfort where memories will be made to last a lifetime. Whether you have a special occasion such as a honeymoon or anniversary or a getaway to join family staying nearby, this is an ideal place for a couple. Days spent in Rosemary Beach offer something for everyone, where you can start your day with morning coffee and a boardwalk stroll. Afternoons are for enjoying the sandy beaches, or poolside at one of the four Rosemary Beach community pools. Guests enjoy access to a myriad of recreation activities, including the Fitness Center, landscaped clay tennis courts and 2 beach cruiser bikes to explore the winding bike paths and neighboring communities. A weekly Farmers Market and frequent live music offer fun sights and sounds, and boutiques line the Main Street for leisurely shopping when a break from the sun is needed! Book now to start your next vacation as our guest! If you’re looking to plan less and experience more, contact the Royal Destinations team to discover your perfect 30A vacation rental. Known for unrivaled guest satisfaction, our team is committed to providing hand-tailored experiences that go beyond the four walls of your 30A luxury vacation rental. Home Highlights: - Carriage House with Gulf Views - Distance to Beach Access: At Beach Access - Parking Spaces: Street Parking Only - Dining Accommodations: Floating Bar 3 - Professional Décor and High-End Appliances - South of 30A Carriage House of Gulf Front Home Community Highlights: - Private Community Beach - Private Beach - 4 Neighborhood Pools - Fitness Center and Racquet Club Access (Extra Charge) - 2 Adult Bikes - Timpoochee Trail - Village Shopping, Dining, Entertainment Home Configuration + Sleeping Arrangements Sleeps: 2 1 Beds / 2 Full Baths Carriage House First Floor: - Living Room, Full Kitchen, Dining Bar, Full Bath, Laundry Carriage House Second Floor: - Bedroom 1: King Bed with Private Bath (Shower) Please Note: *Beach access locations and beach vending companies are subject to change, per local county ordinances. For the most up-to-date information, please contact our office prior to your arrival. Lined with artsy villages, coastal lakes, upscale boutiques, eclectic beach bars, and world-class restaurants, Florida's Scenic Highway 30A has something for everyone. This unique destination has 25,000 acres of protected habitats. Among many things, this area is known for its family-friendly environment and is home to the world's most beautiful white sand beaches. The Timpoochee Trail bike path connects all the villages of 30A. Be sure to take your bike out and explore! The villages of 30A include: Dune Allen Beach, Blue Mountain Beach, Grayton Beach, WaterColor, Seaside, Seagrove Beach, WaterSound, Alys Beach, Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, and Inlet Beach.
